verdict.rationale: Pre-built ML templates are a fair question for a serverless GPU platform like Modal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions templates, pre-built images, or ready-made PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM or ComfyUI environments. The cited material covers GPU selection, containerized deployment in general, and inference endpoints, none of which shows a template catalog.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch
